say:1:1330275001:1.text: Princess Yolena once had me make strange gadgets for her...
say:1:1330275001:1.source_cn: 亚莲娜公主曾吩咐我做一些古怪的道具……但现在她不在了……
say:1:1330275001:1.male: Princess Yolena once had me make strange gadgets for her...
say:1:1330275001:1.female: Princess Yolena once had me make strange gadgets for her...

say:2:1330275002:1.text: The palace did pay me, but it's sad to see the gadgets go to waste.
say:2:1330275002:1.source_cn: 宫廷倒是给了我酬劳，但是这些道具都浪费了，我心里也不好受。
say:2:1330275002:1.male: The palace did pay me, but it's sad to see the gadgets go to waste.
say:2:1330275002:1.female: The palace did pay me, but it's sad to see the gadgets go to waste.

say:3:1330275003:1.text: I wish I could see the princess' face when she received them...
say:3:1330275003:1.source_cn: 真想看看，公主殿下拿到这些道具时高兴的表情啊……
say:3:1330275003:1.male: I wish I could see the princess' face when she received them...
say:3:1330275003:1.female: I wish I could see the princess' face when she received them...
